origin.title: How it started
origin.story: My first builds were Excel tools on a trading desk: tracking portfolio performance and generating client reports automatically, while running daily equity trading operations, client transactions and KYC documentation. In 2023–24 I did PG-DAC at CDAC, and I have been building AI systems professionally since 2024.

profile.name: Lokesh Bothra
profile.title: AI Engineer
profile.tagline: I build AI systems that check their own work.
profile.availability: Open to AI engineering roles working on agents, retrieval and evaluation.
profile.intro: AI engineer building production agentic and RAG systems for enterprise knowledge and scientific computing. LangGraph, multi-agent orchestration, hybrid retrieval, LLM evaluation, FastAPI and GCP. The common thread in my work: agents that verify their evidence, abstain when unsure, and prove their quality with numbers.

sets.name: AegisOps
sets.summary: An agent that detects and investigates incidents over real OpenTelemetry data (logs, metrics, traces and change events) from a 15-service microservice system, and never acts without a human.

steps.title: Detect
steps.detail: Deterministic SQL alert rules over the telemetry store opened an incident 57 s after fault injection in a live test.

steps.title: Triage and plan
steps.detail: A 6-node LangGraph investigation (triage, plan, investigate, change correlation, root cause, verification) with structured outputs.

steps.title: Investigate with tools
steps.detail: 9 read-only telemetry tools exposed over MCP. Tool output is treated as untrusted input to resist prompt injection.

steps.title: Stay on budget
steps.detail: Postgres checkpoints plus hard budgets on tool calls, tokens and time.

steps.title: Human in the loop
steps.detail: Remediation actions can only run after human approval.

check.title: Verify every claim
check.detail: A deterministic evidence verifier checks every trace, log, metric and change the LLM cites against the telemetry store. On the first real run it dropped an invented metric and cut confidence from 0.86 to 0.57.

metrics.label: confidence after catching a hallucinated metric

sets.name: Scientific Literature RAG
sets.summary: A multi-user platform for asking questions of uploaded scientific papers. I took ownership of it and redesigned the pipeline end to end.

steps.title: Chunk by structure
steps.detail: Structure-aware PDF chunking built for scientific documents.

steps.title: Retrieve two ways
steps.detail: Hybrid BM25 + FAISS search with Gemini embedding-001, then BGE cross-encoder reranking.

steps.title: Decompose the question
steps.detail: LangGraph (DeepAgents) pipeline with sub-question decomposition, iterative evidence retrieval and prompt-injection isolation.

steps.title: Keep indexes live
steps.detail: SQLAlchemy metadata with dynamically synchronised FAISS/BM25 indexes: per-user document isolation and hot updates without restarts.

steps.title: Harden for production
steps.detail: API-key auth, SSE streaming, LLM retry and rate limiting, usage analytics and automated tests.

check.title: Abstain and measure
check.detail: Confidence-based abstention instead of guessing, plus an end-to-end RAGAS evaluation framework with custom retrieval metrics tracking faithfulness, relevancy, retrieval quality and answer correctness.

sets.name: AI Sports Analytics
sets.tagline: Ask your data in plain English, get charts back
sets.summary: Backend for a generative-AI sports analytics platform where coaches and analysts query large sports datasets in natural language.

steps.title: Text to SQL
steps.detail: Agents built on Google Agent ADK and Gemini 2.5 Pro turn questions into complex BigQuery SQL.

steps.title: Tools over MCP
steps.detail: Model Context Protocol tools give agents real-time BigQuery access.

steps.title: See beyond text
steps.detail: Multimodal RAG with Docling and Gemini Vision reads charts, tables and screenshots.

steps.title: Sandboxed charts
steps.detail: AI-generated Python runs in a constrained Docker sandbox (llm-sandbox) and streams interactive Plotly charts over SSE.

steps.title: Lock it down
steps.detail: RBAC with Azure AD (Entra ID) and SQLAlchemy maps user groups to BigQuery datasets, isolating coaches from data scientists.

check.title: Validate and self-correct
check.detail: Automated SQL validation and self-correction loops before results reach the user, plus OpenTelemetry tracing and Cloud Build CI/CD.

metrics.label: less DB overhead from short-TTL permission caching

sets.name: Rally
sets.summary: A document-centric RAG assistant for retrieving knowledge from large internal document collections and email.

steps.title: Ingest without blocking
steps.detail: A document server on Docling and Celery for asynchronous ingestion and indexing of very large files.

steps.title: Sync only what changed
steps.detail: Delta-based email sync with the Microsoft Graph API to automate inbox processing.

steps.title: Retrieve fast
steps.detail: Vector retrieval on PostgreSQL (pgvector) with Redis for relevance and latency.

check.title: Measure the win
check.detail: Email handling time dropped by 40% once inbox processing was automated.
